props.body:
At GlowSkin Studio, we believe that great skin is the foundation of confidence. Our clinic in Ikeja, Lagos is a welcoming space where every client receives focused, personalised attention.

We offer a curated menu of skincare and beauty treatments, from deep-cleansing facials to corrective peels and precision lash work. Every session is designed to deliver real, visible results.

items.description: Individually applied lash extensions crafted to complement your eye shape and natural lashes. Long-lasting, natural-looking results.
